statement: codebase/ is a curated, reproducible INPUT SET. The live registry is append-only OPERATIONAL HISTORY. They are different objects and equality between them is not a goal. The condition is CLASSIFICATION, not count: every live name must belong to exactly one declared category, and every required member of every category must be present at the expected artifact. A total-equality check would pass while one legitimate name vanished and one unexplained name appeared.

alias_prefixes.reason: A namespaced mirror of the committed corpus under the operator's reserved prefix, created when namespaces were introduced. Each name must resolve to the SAME artifact as the bare corpus name it mirrors; an alias that drifts is a hash mismatch, not an alias.
